dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Continuous and symmetrical 2D narrowing of the lateral margins from the posterior end of the flipper pockets toward the peduncle, exhibiting a smooth, slightly concave geometric profile.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: High-intensity mature white skin tone with uniform reflectance across the dorsal plane.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Single, low-diameter dark punctate mark on the right lateral margin approximately two-thirds down the body length. A secondary, less-defined faint grey mark is visible on the left side of the posterior dorsal plane.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Centrally located transverse elliptical blowhole indentation at the anterior. A sharp, linear shadow-casting dorsal ridge is clearly visible, bisecting the posterior half of the dorsal surface along the sagittal plane.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Isolated small dark circular mark on the right lateral edge, consistent with a focal pigmentation disruption or healed lesion.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly defined, elongated dorsal ridge that maintains a straight geometric axis from the mid-back to the visible terminus.
